subcategory_text: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-12, CM-13, SI-12
implementation_examples: Maintain a list of the designated data types of interest (e.g., personally identifiable information, protected health information, financial account numbers, organization intellectual property, operational technology data)
Continuously discover and analyze ad hoc data to identify new instances of designated data types
Assign data classifications to designated data types through tags or labels
Track the provenance, data owner, and geolocation of each instance of designated data types
assessment_objectives: Determine whether inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained.

Determine whether activities are conducted to maintain a list of the designated data types of interest (e.g., personally identifiable information, protected health information, financial account numbers, organization intellectual property, operational technology data).
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that continuously discover and analyze ad hoc data to identify new instances of designated data types.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
